name: Sean-nós Singer Máire

intro.text: Sean-nós is old-style singing, unaccompanied, slow and wild. I sing in the round tower. The echo does the harmony.

win: Well sung. And well fought. Two things I rarely say together.
after: Sean-nós means 'old style'. It's one of the oldest ways of singing in Ireland, and it can raise the hairs on your neck.
